summary: Narrow, steep Shirley Street lane squeezed between fences and trees, homes 15 m away.
reasons: Narrow lane, no verge to pull off

best_section.where: North kerb just up from the Shirley Street dead-end bend

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 15 m (at 0 and 19 m) and 20 m; houses and apartments overlook the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane runs kerb-to-fence and tree line; only the bend near 0 m has any space and a no-stopping sign sits there.
drivers.convention: Some cars park along it; 2P weekday 9-5 and no-stopping signs on this side.

flags: No-stopping any time sign near the kerb
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tree canopy on both sides.
